fixture_changes: Isolated physical bay and one Omni; duplicate ambient/fog environment in bay; actual FPS light retained. Enemy callbacks frozen, collisions retained. Film rotations directly controlled; software right movement and RMB; R/B call production APIs with declared resource setup. No rig geometry/material changes.

inventory_after.engine_metric_scope: Whole viewport renderer-reported counters; zero may mean unsupported, not proof of zero memory.
inventory_after.estimate_scope: Conservative RGBA8 full mip chain per unique Texture2D; not measured VRAM; no FPS textures on baseline is valid.

inventory_before.engine_metric_scope: Whole viewport renderer-reported counters; zero may mean unsupported, not proof of zero memory.
inventory_before.estimate_scope: Conservative RGBA8 full mip chain per unique Texture2D; not measured VRAM; no FPS textures on baseline is valid.

limits: Film fixed 30fps is not performance. No physical input, Windows, gaming GPU, continuous viewing or aesthetic PASS established by fixture.
